name: Fuji Speedway
layout: Grand Prix circuit (WEC 6 Hours of Fuji 2026)

sources.geometry: OpenStreetMap way 148622740 "Fuji Speedway" (© OSM contributors), re-centred between the white edge lines measured on GSI aerial photos, 3 m stations; start line at the start gantry seen in the GSI photo
sources.width: Measured from GSI seamless aerial photos (https://cyberjapandata.gsi.go.jp/xyz/seamlessphoto/, z18 ~0.5 m/px): edge line to edge line every 3rd station, rolling median (published 15-25 m); pit-entry and pit-exit merge zones of the main straight set to the 15.2 m measured on the rest of the straight
sources.elevation: GSI 5 m DEM (DEM5A laser survey) via elevation tiles https://cyberjapandata.gsi.go.jp/xyz/dem5a_png/
sources.camber: none (5 m DEM too coarse for crossfall)
sources.trim: 1.5 km main straight vs slow final sector: slightly below Spa downforce (WEC BoP cars, value relative to the F1 Spa scale)
sources.pitLimit: FIA WEC Sporting Regulations: pit lane speed limit 60 km/h
sources.pitLoss: not given: WEC stops are dominated by refuelling/driver-change time that varies by class

notes: F1 does not race here in 2026 (no raceLaps). Turn numbering per the current 16-turn map (T10-12 Dunlop chicane, T16 Panasonic). Start line placed at the start gantry; exact timing-line position not verified.
